batch_upload_hint: Select multiple HTML/asset files (directory structure preserved)
zip_upload_hint: Upload a .zip archive; it will be extracted server-side
project_no_index: This project has no HTML file to display
api_tokens_hint: Personal access tokens let scripts, CI jobs and MCP clients (such as Claude Code) call the HTMLHost REST API as you.
token_created_once_hint: For security, the token is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later. Store it somewhere safe.
token_revoke_confirm: Revoke this token? Any application using it will stop working immediately.
token_usage_hint: Replace $HTMLHOST_TOKEN with the token you created, and you should get back your account details.
mcp_enabled_hint: Allow this user to reach their own content through the REST API and MCP tools.
mcp_disabled_hint: API access has been disabled for your account by an administrator. Existing tokens will not work until it is re-enabled.
mcp_config_hint: What an agent system such as open-webui needs in order to reach HTMLHost over MCP.
public_base_url_hint: Share links and sign-in links returned by the API use this address. Enter the address your users can actually open, e.g. https://html.example.com.
public_base_url_empty_warning: Leaving this empty makes API links fall back to the request's Host header, which under container networking is an internal address users cannot open.
public_base_url_env_hint: Currently falling back to the PUBLIC_BASE_URL environment variable:
public_base_url_must_be_https: The public base URL must start with https://
mcp_server_url_hint: Point open-webui's MCP connection here. This path is served by the separate htmlhost-mcp service; if that runs on its own hostname, substitute it.
mcp_openwebui_version: Requires open-webui ≥ 0.11.4: {{USER_EMAIL}} is injected server-side by open-webui at request time and cannot be forged by a client.
mcp_shared_secret_hint: open-webui uses it to prove the request comes from the trusted gateway. Only its hash is stored, so it can never be displayed again - rotate or revoke it at any time.
mcp_secret_rotate_confirm: Rotating invalidates the current secret immediately; open-webui will keep failing until you update its configuration. Continue?
mcp_secret_revoke_confirm: Trusted-header authentication stops working immediately. Continue?
mcp_secret_created_once_hint: This is the only time it is shown - the database keeps only its hash, so leaving this page means rotating a new one.
mcp_secret_placeholder: The secret is stored as a hash and cannot be shown again - replace <shared-secret> below with the secret you saved, or rotate a new one above if you no longer have it.
mcp_openwebui_config_hint: In open-webui, add this under Settings > Admin Settings > Integrations > External Tool Servers, with type MCP (Streamable HTTP).
mcp_authorized_users_hint: Individual users can be switched off from the user list.

editor_history_empty: No earlier versions yet — every save keeps the previous one here.
editor_history_restore_confirm: Replace the current content with this version? The current content is kept as a version, so this can be undone.
editor_history_conflict: The file was changed in another tab. Close the history panel and open it again.

editor_history_retention: The most recent {n} versions are kept
editor_preview_hint: The content in the editor right now, unsaved changes included
